scope: All 1,012 detailed US industries were individually inspected against the official classification definition and cross-references. Findings establish research implications and parent-treatment exceptions, not source sufficiency or professional accounting conclusions.

rights.external_content: Original definitions are linked, not reproduced. Project-authored summaries and research implications only.
